title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1157: The dependable profound nine (1)

section.p: Not wanting to look at Su Yu’s smug face any longer, Wan Tiansheng grabbed him and vanished. They were heading to Nanyuan.

Meanwhile, Su Yu was once again experiencing a super efficient free ride. They were moving at an incredibly fast speed. As they moved through the void, everything below them turned blurry. Nobody could notice or see them.

Su Yu was starting to suspect that Wan Tiansheng had not been staying in the Heart Cultivating Pavilion, after all. Rather, Old Wan must have left on frequent trips. In any case, nobody had the courage to enter the Heart Cultivating Pavilion without permission. Nobody would know if he was absent.
Even when they were moving at such an incredible speed, Wan Tiansheng did not look tired. Moving at such a speed was as easy as breathing for him.

Once again, Su Yu was reminded of how strong Wan Tiansheng was. In truth, Su Yu’s body was already reaching the standards of a Sunmoon in many aspects. This did not refer to only his offensive strength or the strength he could unleash through consuming blood essence.

The act of forging one’s body was the act of improving one’s body in all aspects. Thus, speed was something Su Yu did not lack as well. But even when trying his best, he would still need an hour or two to reach Nanyuan from the capital.

Of course, this was still a massive improvement compared to his past self. Back when he first traveled to the capital with the convoy, it had taken him two days. Even the journey itself was dangerous. But the so-called danger he had encountered back then was nothing to the current Su Yu. When he moved, the demonic beasts in the wilderness might not even be able to notice his presence.

However, Wan Tiansheng’s speed was at an entirely different level. He didn’t even look like he was trying. After roughly ten minutes, they suddenly stopped. When Su Yu looked down, his expression changed. They had arrived. How fast.

This level of speed was beyond Su Yu’s expectations. In that case, wasn’t it clear that Wan Tiansheng had always been able to interfere in the Starfall Mountain incident back then? But he had remained completely silent, playing his role as a mere peak Mountainsea. How patient.

Su Yu was impressed, but that wouldn’t be the final number. The dao protectors of the myriad race geniuses were probably still on their way. The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion and Myriad Race Cult experts were probably not here yet as well.
If there were already so many Sunmoons here now, wouldn’t there be more than a hundred of them in the end? How many years had it been since so many Sunmoons had gathered in one place?
With a smile, Wan Tiansheng said, “This is a decent number. But it’s not enough. Try to do something with the fake ruin and lure even more people here.”
“Principal, will there be too many people for you to…”
“Don’t worry about it.”

Wan Tiansheng gave a simple reply, and he appeared completely unworried about it. With Su Yu in tow, Wan Tiansheng strolled straight into Su Yu’s house. Nobody could detect them, not the guards outside, and not the Sunmoons in the city.

With a casual swing of his hand, space was ripped apart. The fake ruin produced by Xia Family showed itself beyond the tear in space. There were a decent number of ancient buildings inside with some heavenly source qi. But there was nothing else in it.
Wan Tiansheng said nothing and reached forward. At the next moment, he plucked a character out of the tear in space. The fake ruin produced by Xia Family was made of a character.

Wan Tiansheng tossed it to Su Yu and said, “This is a decent character as well. It’s a Sunmoon character beyond the level of a basic Sunmoon character. It belonged to an eighth-stage Sunmoon divine killed by Xia Longwu in the past.”
Su Yu did not hesitate to catch the character that had been changed into a grotto. Something like this was actually extremely valuable. After all, a grotto represented accumulation and power.

For example, the Source Qi Secret Grotto and Willpower Grotto were both considered the representatives of Great Xia’s accumulation and power. And now, Su Yu had obtained his very first personal grotto.
“But relocation of grottos isn’t supposed to be possible, right?”

“It is possible.” Wan Tiansheng said, “This is not a grotto created by cutting off a chunk of space. Instead, it has been created by stuffing some items inside the character. It does not have that strong of a connection with the space around it. You can move it around easily. In truth, it isn’t a particularly useful grotto. It is only spacious. You can treat it as a bigger storage ring that can also be crushed in an emergency to replenish your willpower.”

Wan Tiansheng might be downplaying the value of this grotto, but any grotto in existence was exceptionally valuable. And Wan Tiansheng knew that very well. A grotto was even more valuable than an unmodified character. Furthermore, this grotto was made from an eighth-stage Sunmoon character, further adding to its value.

However, Wan Tiansheng had forgotten that he was talking to Su Yu. With a nod, Su Yu spoke matter-of-factly, “As an eighth-stage Sunmoon character, it can definitely provide a lot of willpower. Yes, it will do in helping some of my characters advance.”
Wan Tiansheng started cursing inwardly. He was merely putting up an act to look impressive. The grotto was actually very valuable. Why the fuck was the kid taking his words at face value?
Screw this damn kid! Was the kid actually thinking of crushing it for cultivation? That would be too wasteful!
Not wanting to talk about this topic any longer, he asked, “Where do you think the ruin entrance should be?”
“Inside the toilet bowl.”
Wan Tiansheng resisted the urge to curse again.
But soon, he laughed, “Yes. The toilet bowl will serve as the entrance. To enter the ruin, one needs to go down the toilet bowl.”

Fine, fine. Wan Tiansheng did not mind this. It wasn’t like he was planning to enter the ruin himself. He strode into the bathroom and tore space apart again. The tearing of space generated some weak spatial undulations, but he was able to fully suppress them from spreading further.
As he unfurled his palm, an entire world appeared above it. Then, he stuffed the fake ruin into the tear in space. After a while, a seal was placed over the tear in space.
“I’ll only leave a small opening right in the toilet bowl. The spatial undulations will be extremely weak, to the point only Pseudo Invincibles can detect them.”
Wan Tiansheng explained while pointing at a certain spot in the toilet bowl.
Su Yu nodded and said, “Will this opening widen as time passes?”
“Yes.”
Good.

When Su Yu focused, he could sense faint traces of heavenly source qi coming out of the toilet bowl. The heavenly source qi leaking out was so thin that it would fully dissipate before it fully left the toilet bowl. Unless one was extremely focused while searching, it would be too easy to entirely miss it.
One ought to know that someone like Su Yu was extremely sensitive to heavenly source qi. If even he could barely notice this, it would be much harder for others to notice as well.
“What else do we need to do?” Wan Tiansheng asked, “If this is all, I’ll be taking my leave now.”
“Sure. I can handle the rest of the job myself.”
Suddenly, he thought of something. With some hesitation, he said, “Uhm, Principal…is the Xia Family aware of what we’re doing?”
The two looked at each other and said nothing. The Xia Family…did not seem to know about this.

Su Yu wondered if the Xia Family would think that an actual ruin was actually here when they finally noticed it. He might have complained about their fake ruin to them, but they were probably unaware that he actually had several carrier treasures on him.
Thus, when this ruin started making its appearance, the Xia Family might really believe that it was a real ruin.
Wan Tiansheng thought about it and laughed, “There is no need to tell them about this. That way, their reaction to this will be a lot more natural and believable.”

Su Yu had the urge to roll his eyes. Inwardly, he was thinking that this was Old Wan’s idea, not his. The Xia Family better not blame him for toying with their feelings. With nothing else to say, Wan Tiansheng vanished with a flicker.

At that moment, Su Yu finally recalled something. He was quite speechless. Why did the principal leave alone? Why did the principal leave him in the city? Was the principal not aware of how dangerous this place was? There were over thirty Sunmoons in the city!

Oh well…no big deal. The deceit and culture characters fused. Instantly, Su Yu’s presence vanished. Coupled with his white mask, he became even harder to detect than before. Then, the calm character activated, keeping everyone nearby calm.
Finally, he turned into mist before sneaking out of the building. There were some Martial Dragon Guard soldiers stationed outside, but nobody noticed anything.

In an unhurried manner, Su Yu sank into the ground and started searching the city, investigating the locations and strength of the experts in the city. With the Perception Jade, nobody within a kilometer could hide from him.

In fact, there were also some experts hidden underground. Some were searching for the ruin while some were spies like Su Yu. Naturally, they were no match to Su Yu in terms of concealment. After a while, Su Yu reached a decision.
“Enforcer White One, take a few white masks with you and wait for me near the northern gate. Be ready to provide support. I’ll be leaving the city.”
He sent a short message.
White One blanked out slightly before replying, “Are you fine?”
“I’m fine, but the risk of being discovered is higher when leaving the city. I also need to announce something to the people in the city.”
“What are you planning?”
“Don’t ask. Just be on standby. I’ll be leaving soon.”
“Sure.”

White One did not ask more questions. He was quite surprised. Profound Nine was actually able to sneak into the city undetected. He wondered if there was any new discovery. That fellow was getting more and more brazen.

After about half an hour, Su Yu received a message from White One. He had arrived with a few other individuals. They were waiting around a kilometer from the northern gate. They did not dare to approach the city too much.
